text.text: The supreme great blade is the station's full form: one handle, two blades and two saya, all five parts on the bench and every number stacked.

Durability = (main blade + second blade) durability × handle durability × 1.2; attack = (main + second) attack × handle attack + half of each saya's attack × 2 + 1. All five parts may be different materials.
Colour, slash art and repair material follow the main blade; the second blade's trait counts at 75%, the handle and both saya at 50% each.
A great blade blank can be forged directly, but that is only a down payment: filling all five slots is the real thing.
